summary: Phase 149O.11 -- HATP Signing Ceremony + Evidence Store Implementation Plan: implementation-plan-only phase (no HSCE-001/HATP-001/RAE-001 amendment, no production implementation, no CLI implementation, no hardware provisioning, no signing execution, no .pcae/hatp-evidence/ directory created). Ran the full required initial inspection (git status/log/rev-list, pcae health/check/status coherence/doctor task-memory/push check/runtime inspect, telegram notify status, phase-report show --latest and reconcile --phase-id 149O.10.2) and confirmed the expected baseline: repo clean, origin/main..HEAD=0, 149O.10.2 completed/complete/pushed/consistent, HSCE-001 v1.1 VERIFIED WITH NON-BLOCKING FINDINGS -- CONFORMS -- READY FOR IMPLEMENTATION PLANNING, HATP production NOT READY, runtime Observed/observe/unavailable. Read the full HSCE-001 v1.1 canonical contract text directly (docs/contracts/HATP_SIGNING_CEREMONY_EVIDENCE_STORE_CONTRACT.md, 1227 lines, not trusting phase summaries), the 149O.8/149O.9/149O.10/149O.10.1/149O.10.2 phase docs, HATP-001 and RAE-001 contracts, and the full current production source (human_approval_trusted_provenance.py, hatp_providers.py, hatp_fido2_provider.py, hatp_hardware_credentials.py, hatp_bootstrap.py, hatp_ag_authority.py, rollback_approval_evidence.py, repository_identity.py, agent.py, commands/agent.py, cli.py) to establish exact existing function/class names and signatures rather than inventing plausible-sounding ones. Independently reconfirmed the 79-requirement inventory (HSCE-REQ-001..079, sequential, gapless) and 21-item mandatory attack matrix directly from the contract text. Produced a complete requirement-traceability table mapping every one of the 79 requirements to exactly one primary module owner (three new core modules -- hatp_signed_evidence.py, hatp_evidence_store.py, hatp_signing_ceremony.py -- plus commands/hatp.py and a registration-only cli.py edit; narrative/contract-history requirements explicitly marked as such rather than force-mapped to fake code) plus, where applicable, a test owner and attack relationship. Produced a complete 21-attack traceability table plus 4 additional implementation-level attacks (Obs-3-derived loser-read-failure, temp-FD-mutation, many-writer race, non-EEXIST link error), each with a concrete future test file. Mapped all 12 SC-1..SC-12 security invariants to future tests, all 12 closed error_type values and all 9 exit codes to owning modules. Designed the exact exclusive hard-link publication algorithm (11 numbered steps, matching HSCE-REQ-052's repaired text precisely: canonical serialize, same-directory unique temp file via tempfile.mkstemp, write+fsync+close before any link attempt, os.link attempt, winner/loser/other-OSError branches, symlink pre-checks, existing-object-type validation before loser comparison, unconditional temp cleanup) as a new, independently-defined helper distinct from and not reusing rollback_approval_evidence.py's _write_atomic_json (which lacks symlink checks and uses os.replace, per the 149O.10-F-2 lesson this plan explicitly avoids repeating). Resolved the open 149O.10.2-Obs-3 finding (loser-comparison read-failure error_type gap) by selecting evidence_persistence_failure as the implementation-level mapping, with documented rationale grounded in HSCE-REQ-052 step 7's own existing fail-closed default -- explicitly framed as an implementation-level diagnostic mapping, not an HSCE-001 amendment; no new error_type introduced. Designed the envelope model (frozen dataclass, constructor/parser domain equivalence per the B-149O.1H-2 lesson, explicit bool-rejecting version validation mirroring _require_proof_version, evidence-ID derived internally by the production builder rather than accepted from an independent caller-supplied value), the AG3/AG5 proof-context resolver and TOCTOU recheck strategy (context captured once at proof-construction time, re-resolved and compared before persistence, discard-not-republish on mismatch, no automatic re-sign), the signing-ceremony orchestrator's test-seam layering (keyword-only factory/clock/confirm parameters defaulting to production implementations, zero overrides on the actual CLI call path -- mirroring the existing F-2 production-adapter lesson), and the CLI grammar/forbidden-flag inventory/optional-fido2-dependency boundary. Selected the governing prompt's proposed Wave A-F decomposition (dependency-ordered: model -> store -> resolver -> orchestrator -> CLI -> integration tests) and recommended splitting the future implementation across three bounded phases (149O.12A model+store, 149O.12B resolver+orchestrator, 149O.12C CLI+integration) rather than one monolithic implementation phase, followed by a dedicated independent-verification phase (149O.13) before any AG3/AG5 consumption-wiring work is even proposed. Ran a mechanical plan-completeness check: independent regex extraction of every HSCE-REQ-### token referenced in the produced plan document confirmed all 79 (001-079) present with no gaps; git diff --stat for src/pcae/ confirmed empty; docs/contracts/ confirmed untouched; .pcae/hatp-evidence/ confirmed does not exist. VERDICT: HATP SIGNING CEREMONY + EVIDENCE STORE IMPLEMENTATION PLAN: COMPLETE -- READY FOR IMPLEMENTATION. No production code modified. HSCE-001 v1.1, HATP-001 v1.0, and RAE-001 v1.0 all remain byte-unchanged by this phase. B-149O-1..4 remain INDEPENDENTLY VERIFIED AT HATP-GATED AUTHORITY BOUNDARY -- SYSTEM EXECUTION CLOSURE DEFERRED. HATP production remains NOT READY. Runtime remains Observed / observe / unavailable. Full detail in docs/PHASE_149O_11_HATP_SIGNING_CEREMONY_EVIDENCE_STORE_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md. Recommended next phase: 149O.12A, Signed Evidence Model + Evidence Store Implementation.
